AnduinFlashHealEvenhandedBlessings.name: Evenhanded Blessings
AnduinFlashHealEvenhandedBlessings.description: If Flash Heal is cast on a different target from its last, increase its healing by 15% and refund 40% of its cooldown.

AnduinDivineStarPowerWordShield.name: Power Word: Shield
AnduinDivineStarPowerWordShield.description: While Divine Star is traveling out, allies in its path gain a Shield that absorbs 128 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds. If Divine Star hits an enemy Hero, Anduin gains a Shield that absorbs 185 (+4% per level) damage for 4 seconds.

AnduinLightwell.name: Lightwell
AnduinLightwell.description: Summon a Lightwell that periodically heals a nearby allied Hero for 50 (+4% per level). The well only fades after healing 15 times or when recast. This cooldown is reduced by 1 second each time Anduin heals an allied Hero.

AnduinDivineStarMoralCompass.name: Moral Compass
AnduinDivineStarMoralCompass.description: Divine Star fires Basic Attacks at Heroes close to its apex. Passive: Increase Attack Range by 1.1.

AnduinSurgeofLight.name: Surge of Light
AnduinSurgeofLight.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Chastise by 0.75 seconds. Basic Attacks against Heroes Rooted by Chastise launch an additional Basic Attack and restore 25 Mana.

AnduinPiercingLight.name: Piercing Light
AnduinPiercingLight.description: Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero. Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

AnduinFlashHealBindingHeal.name: Binding Heal
AnduinFlashHealBindingHeal.description: Casting Flash Heal on an ally heals Anduin for 135 (+4% per level).

AnduinBlessedRecovery.name: Blessed Recovery
AnduinBlessedRecovery.description: If Anduin loses more than 8% of his maximum Health at once, recover 15% Health over 3 seconds. This effect has a 10 second cooldown. Current Health required: 133 (+4% per level)

AnduinFlashHealDesperatePrayer.name: Desperate Prayer
AnduinFlashHealDesperatePrayer.description: Activate to instantly heal an allied Hero for 375 (+4% per level), but kneel for 2 seconds, unable to act.

AnduinHolyWordSalvation.name: Holy Word: Salvation
AnduinHolyWordSalvation.description: After 0.5 seconds, Channel to invoke the Light for 3 seconds. While nearby, allied Heroes heal for up to 30% of their max Health and are Protected.

AnduinLightBomb.name: Lightbomb
AnduinLightBomb.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds. The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

AnduinDivineStarSpeedOfThePious.name: Speed of the Pious
AnduinDivineStarSpeedOfThePious.description: While Divine Star is traveling, gain 30% Movement Speed. Each allied Hero healed by Divine Star on its return to Anduin reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

AnduinPushForward.name: Push Forward!
AnduinPushForward.description: Damaging an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 2.5% and the amount healed by Pursued By Grace by 5% for 6 seconds. These effects stack up to 8 times.

AnduinLeapOfFaithEnchantBootsLionsSpeed.name: Enchant Boots - Lion's Speed
AnduinLeapOfFaithEnchantBootsLionsSpeed.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. This bonus is quadrupled while Leap of Faith's cooldown is available. Allies pulled by Leap of Faith are healed for 280 (+4% per level) over 4 seconds.

AnduinFlashHealRenew.name: Renew
AnduinFlashHealRenew.description: Flash Heal heals an additional 180 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds. The duration of this heal is refreshed each time Anduin hits an enemy Hero with a Basic Attack.

AnduinDivineStarHolyNova.name: Holy Nova
AnduinDivineStarHolyNova.description: After Anduin catches Divine Star, it explodes, healing nearby allied Heroes for 105 (+4% per level) and damaging enemies for 150 (+4% per level).

AnduinLeapOfFaithGlyphOfFaith.name: Glyph of Faith
AnduinLeapOfFaithGlyphOfFaith.description: Leap of Faith gains a 2nd charge.

AnduinFlashHealInnerFocus.name: Inner Focus
AnduinFlashHealInnerFocus.description: Activate to reset the cooldown of Flash Heal and its next cast heals for 25% more. Damaging enemy Heroes reduces this cooldown by 1 second.

AnduinHolyWordSalvationLightOfStormwind.name: Light of Stormwind
AnduinHolyWordSalvationLightOfStormwind.description: Holy Word: Salvation grants allied Heroes Invulnerability instead of Protected. This does not affect Anduin. Channeling Holy Word: Salvation for its full duration reduces its cooldown by 60 seconds.

AnduinInnerFire.name: Inner Fire
AnduinInnerFire.description: The target of Light Bomb gains 40% Move Speed and 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

AnduinCensure.name: Censure
AnduinCensure.description: Chastise Stuns for 0.75 seconds and its Root duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

AnduinVariansLegacy.name: Varian's Legacy
AnduinVariansLegacy.description: Basic Attacks burn enemies for 87 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds and Anduin heals for 50% of the damage dealt.
